intent: Bounded context Account Lifecycle (account): Inspect and refactor AccountApplicationService for clean naming, small methods, immutability, null-safety and layer boundaries without changing behavior or weakening these invariants: Use cases: open account, activate, freeze, terminate, approve overdraft, place/release hold, convert hold on PaymentSettledEvent idempotently. Depends on ports (AccountRepository, CustomerVerificationPort anticorruption port for KYC, EventPublisher outbox port, ProcessedEventStore); publishes AccountCreated/AccountFrozen/FundsReserved/FundsReleased.
